acceptance_evidence.AC1_validated_system_suggestions_only: SystemSuggestionsPanel and getTradingRoomSystemSuggestions / getDecisionEventSystemSuggestions render validated system suggestions relevant to the active decision with evidence_refs, validation_result_id/link, and attribution_record_id/link, while strictly filtering out any unvalidated or luck_or_unsupported hypotheses at both client and component boundaries.
acceptance_evidence.AC2_shadow_comparisons_and_settlement_la: ShadowComparisonPanel and getTradingRoomShadowComparison display the trader's own shadow comparisons across all arms (trader, base_strategy, private_servant, institutional_view) with settlement source labels; paper proxy is classified as paper_proxy (data-actual-fill=false) and never shown as an actual fill.
acceptance_evidence.AC3_advice_only_no_order_or_capital_cont: Both panels are strictly read-only / advice-only (execution_authority=none, no_order_route_proof=agora_decision_support_only) and expose no control that places an order or changes capital.
acceptance_evidence.AC4_component_and_regression_tests: SystemSuggestionsPanel.test.tsx (7 tests), ShadowComparisonPanel.test.tsx (7 tests), tradingRoom.test.ts (60 tests), TradingRoomWorkspace.test.tsx (20 tests), TradingRoomPage.test.tsx (66 tests), i18nParity.test.ts (13 tests), i18n.guard.test.ts (3 tests), and sessionTransportCoverage.test.ts (6 tests) pass against recorded BFF responses.
